name: JSON Schema Validator
description: Validate JSON against Draft 2020-12 or Draft 7 with precise error paths
help: Paste JSON and its schema, or open UTF-8 JSON files of up to 2 MiB each. Select the draft, validate, then copy or save the diagnostic report.

The selected draft is explicit: a conflicting $schema declaration is reported instead of silently changing dialects. Enable format checks to validate built-in formats such as email and date-time; unknown formats remain annotations.

Only fragment references in the submitted document, such as #/$defs/user, are accepted. External, relative-file and network references are rejected. No schema files or URLs are downloaded automatically.

Inputs are limited to 2 MiB each, depth 64 and 50,000 JSON nodes. Numbers allow up to 4,096 bytes and exponent magnitude 10,000. Schemas allow 4,096 schema nodes, 256 combinator branches, 128 patterns and 4,096 bytes per pattern. Regular expressions have a 1 MiB compilation budget and 10,000 backtracking steps. Up to 200 diagnostics are returned.

Validation runs as a background task. Cancellation and the 10-second processing budget are checked between stages and diagnostics; a single schema compilation or validation step must finish before they can take effect.

Error paths use JSON Pointer. For schema errors, Document path points into your schema and Meta-schema path identifies its rule. Syntax errors can be clicked to jump to their line. Editing inputs marks existing results as outdated.

Keys are limited to 512 bytes, generated paths to 2,048 bytes, and estimated schema expansion to 100,000 operations with a 16 MiB path-memory budget. Relative $id values, non-empty fragments in $id and duplicate resource IDs are not supported.
